motors.name: AXI 2820/10
motors.notes: Popular 28mm-class outrunner, widely used in 400-700g electric gliders/trainers.

motors.name: AXI 2826/10
motors.notes: Longer-can 28mm outrunner, slightly higher torque than the 2820/10.

motors.name: Scorpion SII-2212-9
motors.notes: Small 22mm-class outrunner suitable for park flyers and small trainers.

motors.name: Scorpion SII-3014-1050
motors.notes: 30mm-class outrunner, good for 1.2-1.8m sport aircraft.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2814
motors.notes: Fixed-wing outrunner marketed for trainers/sport planes in the 1.2-1.8kg class.

motors.name: Skywalker 2212 2250Kv
motors.notes: No single verified factory datasheet exists for an exact 2250Kv SKU under the Skywalker brand -- Hobbywing's real Skywalker line jumps from 1400Kv straight to 2450Kv (2312 series), and this filler value is common on generic 2212-class motors sold alongside the popular 'Skywalker' foam FPV wing. Specs here are interpolated from the documented 2200Kv A2212-class and 2450Kv Skywalker 2312SL datasheets, not a confirmed factory spec sheet -- verify against your actual part before trusting for a build.

motors.name: Skywalker 2826SL 540Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (hobbywing.com), 35.1x66mm can, 6S LiPo, 12N14P. Max continuous current/power rated for 1 minute (49.7A / 1106.5W). Recommended props: 12x6E, 13x6.5E, 14x6. Recommended ESC: Skywalker 80A. No published burst/peak rating -- I_max_burst left null rather than guessed.

motors.name: Skywalker 2826SL 850Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (hobbywing.com), 35.1x66mm can, 3-4S LiPo. Max continuous current/power rated for ~2 min (69A / 1006.5W). Recommended props: 12x6E, 13x6.5E. Recommended ESC: Skywalker 80A. No published burst/peak rating -- I_max_burst left null rather than guessed.

motors.name: Skywalker 2826SL 1100Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (hobbywing.com), 35.1x66mm can, 3-4S LiPo. Max continuous current/power rated for ~2min15s (82.4A / 1218.9W). Recommended props: 10x5E, 11x5.5E. Recommended ESC: Skywalker 80A. No published burst/peak rating -- I_max_burst left null rather than guessed.

motors.name: Skywalker 2312SL 2450Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (hobbywing.com), 28.8x46mm can, 3S LiPo. Max continuous current/power rated for 10 min (47A / 520W) -- a much longer duty cycle than the 2826SL entries, reflecting its smaller/higher-Kv park-flyer role. Recommended props: 5x3E, 6x6E. Recommended ESC: Skywalker-V2 20A-50A. Smallest, highest-Kv motor in the bundled Skywalker family -- good direct-drive option alongside the 2826SL series for comparison sweeps.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2317 880Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com). Max current/power rated for 180s duration. Recommended cells 2-4S; T-Motor pairs this with a 12x6 prop and AT40A/AT55A ESC on their listing, but at 79g/22mm-class this is sized more for a 4x9in-class quad layout than a 2x12in twin -- included in the 9in-class group. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2317 1250Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com). Max current/power rated for 180s duration. Recommended cells 2-4S. 9in-class quad-layout candidate. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2317 1400Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com). Max current/power rated for 180s duration. Recommended cells 2-4S. 9in-class quad-layout candidate. No published burst rating.

motors.name: Scorpion SII-2212-960Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (scorpionsystem.com). Max 4S LiPo. Compact 22mm-class outrunner, 9in-class quad-layout candidate. No published burst rating.

motors.name: SunnySky X2212 980Kv
motors.notes: Retailer-published datasheet (multiple independent listings agree on these numbers), not a first-party SunnySky PDF. Widely used 22mm-class motor for small multirotor/quad layouts. Shaft diameter not confirmed from source -- left null rather than guessed (commonly 3.17mm for this class, but unverified). No published burst rating.

motors.name: SunnySky X2212 1400Kv
motors.notes: Retailer-published datasheet (multiple independent listings agree on these numbers), not a first-party SunnySky PDF. Widely used 22mm-class motor for small multirotor/quad layouts. Shaft diameter not confirmed from source -- left null rather than guessed. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2820 880Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com), 3-4S LiPo. T-Motor's own recommended props for this variant: APC 11x7, 12x6, 13x6.5, 14x7 -- a direct match for a 2x12in twin layout. Max current/power rated for 180s duration. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2820 1050Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com), 3-4S LiPo. T-Motor's own recommended props for this variant: APC 11x5.5, 11x8, 12x6, 13x6.5 -- a direct match for a 2x12in twin layout. Max current/power rated for 180s duration. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2820 1250Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com), 3-4S LiPo. T-Motor's own recommended props for this variant: APC 9x6, 10x5.5, 11x8, 12x6 -- spans both the 9in and 12in classes depending on how it's paired. Max current/power rated for 180s duration. No published burst rating.

motors.name: Scorpion SII-3020-890Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (scorpionsystem.com). Max 5S LiPo. 30mm-class outrunner, good 2x12in twin-layout candidate alongside the AT2820 family. No published burst rating.

motors.name: T-Motor AT2826 900Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com), 3-4S LiPo, 35.2x69.5mm can, 12N14P. T-Motor's own recommended prop is APC 13x6.5 with an AT75A ESC -- pairs well with a 2x12in twin layout. Max current/power rated for 180s duration (57A / 820W). No published burst rating. A KV1100 variant is also listed on the same page, but its published internal resistance (110mOhm) and max power (110W, lower than this KV900 variant despite being the higher-Kv/higher-current option) are internally inconsistent with every other multi-Kv motor family in this library (higher Kv normally means lower R, not 4.5x higher) -- two independent fetches of the same page reproduced the same numbers, so it reads as an error on T-Motor's own spec page rather than a scraping artifact. Omitted rather than entered with suspect data; re-add if a corrected datasheet turns up.

motors.name: Cobra C-3520/12 820Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (innov8tivedesigns.com, official US Cobra Motors distributor). Cobra publishes two resistance figures -- 'per phase' (0.039 Ohm) and 'phase to phase' (0.026 Ohm); this model's V_batt - I*R_total convention matches a terminal (line-to-line) measurement, i.e. phase-to-phase, consistent with the single unqualified value every other brand in this library quotes -- corrected from an earlier per-phase entry. No-load current measured at 14V. Rated max continuous power scales with cell count (620W@3S / 830W@4S / 1040W@5S) -- a 35mm-class outrunner, good 2x12in twin-layout candidate alongside the AT2820/SII-3020 family. No published burst/peak rating or specific prop recommendation on this page.

motors.name: Cobra C-2217/16 1180Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (innov8tivedesigns.com, official US Cobra Motors distributor). Phase-to-phase resistance used (0.070 Ohm) per this library's convention -- per-phase figure was 0.105 Ohm. No-load current measured at 8V. Rated 265W max continuous power @ 3S. Compact 22mm-class outrunner, 9in-class quad-layout candidate alongside the AT2317/SII-2212 family. No published burst rating or specific prop recommendation on this page.

motors.name: BadAss 2826-1030Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (innov8tivedesigns.com; BadAss is Innov8tive Designs' own house brand, designed by their CEO). Phase-to-phase resistance used (0.018 Ohm) per this library's convention -- per-phase figure was 0.027 Ohm. No-load current measured at 10V. Rated max continuous power scales with cell count (780W@3S / 1040W@4S / 1300W@5S / 1550W@6S). 28mm-class outrunner, good 2x12in twin-layout candidate alongside the Skywalker 2826SL family. New brand, first BadAss entry in this library. No published burst rating or specific prop recommendation on this page.

motors.name: BadAss 3520-650Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (innov8tivedesigns.com; BadAss is Innov8tive Designs' own house brand). Phase-to-phase resistance used (0.021 Ohm) per this library's convention -- per-phase figure was 0.032 Ohm. No-load current measured at 10V. Rated max power scales with cell count (710W@3S / 950W@4S / 1180W@5S / 1420W@6S). 35mm-class outrunner, larger/lower-Kv 2x12in twin option alongside the AT2820/SII-3020/Cobra C-3520 family. No published burst rating or specific prop recommendation on this page.

motors.name: T-Motor AT3520 550Kv
motors.notes: Factory datasheet (store.tmotor.com), 4-6S LiPo. T-Motor's own recommended prop is APC 13x6.5 or 14x7 -- larger than the 12in target, so this is a stretch fit included for a higher-payload 2-motor option; verify it actually pairs well with a 12in prop in the sweep before trusting it. Max current/power rated for 180s duration. No published burst rating.
